scope: Four T-cell identity/state/function asset paths captured at both pins, with six new classification entries and two protected original teaching entries. Bounded complete parent/shared context is explicitly reused; this is not a replacement ordinary-lesson denominator.

units.requirement: The two separate six-symbol populations and R1/R2 identifiers are fictional observations, not an empirical sample, frequency estimate or patient outcome.
Equal PD-1 observations and proximity to cancer do not establish equal antigen specificity or tumor-directed recognition.
The stipulated controlled viral-peptide response for R1 and tumor-peptide response for R2 answer a target-response question under that test, not a cell-state diagnosis.
A controlled peptide response does not establish natural tumor antigen processing and display.
A controlled peptide response does not establish physical access to tumor cells.
A controlled peptide response does not establish natural tumor killing, safe clinical activity or patient benefit.
PD-1 observation alone does not assign exhaustion or promise checkpoint-mediated functional rescue.
Checkpoint treatment is not a receptor-specificity rewrite; a viral-peptide response is not converted into a tumor-peptide response by the schematic.
The same paired-receptor identifier R1 can be attached to different independently observed history and program contexts; receptor identity is not itself a state label.
Observation A stipulates prior response and resolved stimulation with a memory-associated context.
Observation B stipulates persistent stimulation with a progenitor-like exhausted context; this is not ordinary memory merely renamed.
The two observations have no transition arrow and demonstrate neither a measured memory-to-exhaustion transition nor a universal developmental path.
Naive denotes that initial antigen-driven activation has not yet occurred; the card is a response-history definition.
Effector functions develop after activation and differ by cell role; effector is not a guarantee of tumor killing.
Memory denotes persistence and potential for a renewed response, not guaranteed permanent protection or one mandatory destination.
Exhaustion denotes a persistent-stimulation-associated program with altered function, rather than an observation of inactivity alone.
The four cards are separate contexts and do not imply a universal naive-to-effector-to-memory-to-exhaustion sequence.
Regulatory T-cell roles are separate from a worn-out effector state; the shared receipt does not redefine regulation as exhaustion.

The shared subset guardrail keeps progenitor-like exhaustion distinct from ordinary memory and rejects assignment of state, specificity or clinical benefit from a single marker or schematic connector.
Review, code-authorship, transfer-only, pixel-preservation and expert/learner status statements in the shared receipt are inherited attestations, not present approvals.
Historical owner, source, prompt, package and artwork hashes must be compared with named public pinned bytes; unmatched or private targets are not approvals and are not silently substituted.
The shared receipt binds eight artwork variants; two exhausted-subset native views and the complete parent/context reading are reused only after exact whole-source and render-hash verification.
The complete shared JSON body was physically read in the prior cohort and is reused by exact hash here; only the three newly assigned dark SVG XML bodies receive a fresh full-body read claim.

The three new light/dark families use CSS custom properties. Successful native-size views use private variable-resolved render copies; the source files stay unchanged and no live browser, mobile, contrast or accessibility acceptance is claimed.
The two already-teaching original entries retain their entire prior grades and evidence unchanged; only six previously unclassified version entries receive new dispositions.
The controlled-test heading nearly reaches the right edge in both native renders; this is a low-severity layout observation, without a source-science defect or product edit.
Both ordinary inventories, prior source depth, pending packets and unassigned assets remain preserved; no independent, expert, owner, learner, language, main or live credit is granted.
